title: Why Choose Brant's Termite & Pest Control
intro: We provide reliable, professional pest control designed to eliminate pests and protect your property long-term — with the kind of service you only get from a local, owner-operated company.

points.title: Licensed & Insured
points.text: Professional, fully licensed and insured service on every job — home or business.

points.title: Local & Trusted
points.text: Locally owned and operated in Warrensburg. You'll deal with the owner, not a call center.

points.title: Residential & Commercial
points.text: Homes, rentals, apartment complexes, restaurants, offices, warehouses, and city properties.

points.title: Safe for Families & Pets
points.text: Targeted treatments applied with your kids, pets, and property in mind.

points.title: Fast Response
points.text: Pest problems don't wait, and neither do we. Call and we'll get you on the schedule quickly.

points.title: Monthly Plans Available
points.text: Ongoing protection plans that keep pests out year-round — not just for a few weeks.
